briefing: This is {PATRON}, speaking from {HERE}. There is an Anaconda working the neighbour system, and I want eyes kept on it.
Hold it on your scanner for twenty seconds. Do not fire, do not provoke it, just watch and report back.
dossier.lead: {PATRON} at {WORLD} has sent word, wanting a moment of the commander's time.

watch.arrive: Hold the Anaconda on your scanner at {TARGET} without firing, for {PAY}
watch.success: You held the Anaconda at {TARGET} without firing, and earned {PAY}
watch.fail: The Anaconda got away at {TARGET}, and {PAY} stays unpaid

dossier.news: {PATRON} at {WORLD} is offering steady pay to any pilot who can hold a scan.

rumour.far: Some say {PATRON} at {WORLD} is paying well to have a ship watched.
rumour.near: {PATRON} sends word from {WORLD} that the ship still needs watching.

story.opening: On day {DAY}, the commander took on a watching job at {WORLD}.

closing.complete: By day {DAY}, the watch had paid off, and the commander's job at {WORLD} was done.
closing.fail: By day {DAY}, the watch had failed, and the job at {WORLD} was lost.

watch.success: On day {DAY}, the commander held the Anaconda at {WORLD} for the full watch.
watch.targetDestroyed: On day {DAY}, the Anaconda was destroyed at {WORLD} before the watch was done.
watch.targetEscaped: On day {DAY}, the Anaconda slipped away from the scanner at {WORLD}.
watch.failed: On day {DAY}, the watch at {WORLD} ran out before it was done.

dossier.title: Eyes on the Anaconda
